Metadata.title: Spirit of Santa Admin
Metadata.description: Internal administration for the Spirit of Santa team.

HomePage.title: Spirit of Santa Admin
HomePage.intro: Sign in with your team account to continue.
HomePage.pendingStores: {count, plural, =0 {No stores waiting for review} one {# store waiting for review} other {# stores waiting for review}}

StoreAdmin.discountHint: For example 20 or 17.5. The store bills Spirit of Santa the retail price minus this discount.
StoreAdmin.inviteIntro: The owner gets an email link (valid 7 days) to set a password and accept the agreement. The store is approved as soon as they accept.

errors.badStatus: This store's status changed meanwhile. Refresh the page and try again.
errors.emailInUse: That email already has an account.
errors.ownerUnverified: The owner hasn't confirmed their email yet, so the store can't be approved.
errors.alreadyInvited: This email already has a pending invitation. Open that store to resend or cancel it.

StoreAdmin.ownerUnverifiedNote: The owner hasn't confirmed their email address yet. You can approve the store once they do. Unconfirmed sign-ups are removed automatically after 48 hours.
StoreAdmin.rejectReasonNoEmail: Reason (internal note; no email is sent because the owner's address isn't confirmed)
StoreAdmin.emailFailedNotice: Saved, but the email could not be sent. Try resending it later.
StoreAdmin.inviteEmailFailed: The store was created, but the invitation email could not be sent. Open the store and use "Resend invitation".
StoreAdmin.doneApprove: Store approved. The owner has been emailed.
StoreAdmin.doneResend: A new invitation was sent. Older links no longer work.

MfaSetup.title: Set up two-step sign-in
MfaSetup.intro: Admin accounts need a code from an authenticator app as well as a password. This takes about two minutes.
MfaSetup.step1: Install an authenticator app on your phone if you don't have one: Google Authenticator, Microsoft Authenticator or 1Password all work.
MfaSetup.step2: In the app, add an account and scan this QR code.
MfaSetup.qrAlt: QR code for your authenticator app
MfaSetup.manualLabel: Can't scan it? Choose "enter a setup key" in the app and type this key:
MfaSetup.step3: Type the 6-digit code the app shows now.

errors.invalidCode: That code didn't match. Codes change every 30 seconds: type the one showing now. If it keeps failing, check your phone's clock is set automatically.
errors.expired: This setup took too long. Reload the page for a new QR code and scan it again.
errors.rateLimited: Too many tries. Wait 15 minutes, then try again.
errors.notFound: Two-step sign-in is already on, or this account can't use it. Reload the page.

MfaSetup.recoveryIntro: Save these 10 recovery codes somewhere safe, like a password manager or a printed copy. If you lose your phone, type one in the code box when you sign in. Each works once. They won't be shown again.
MfaSetup.saveFirst: Tick the box once you've saved them.
MfaSetup.signInAgainNeeded: Two-step sign-in is on. Sign in again with your password and a code from the app.
MfaSetup.alreadyOn: Two-step sign-in is already on for your account.

Season.title: Season settings
Season.intro: The season runs all year: families earn Christmas Magic from January 1, wish lists freeze December 1, the last day is Christmas Day and the site is closed December 26–31. Every change is recorded in the audit log.

phase.open: Open: families earn and build lists
phase.resetting: Starting the new season (January 1 reset running)

Season.datesLine: Open all year · freezes {freeze} · stores ship by {shipBy} · last day {lastDay}
Season.windowIntro: When stores can add, edit and price items. Stock counts can always be updated.

window.autoHelp: Open January 1 – March 31, closed the rest of the year.
window.openHelp: Stores can change their lists until you switch this back (e.g. to onboard stores early).
window.closedHelp: No list changes, even during January – March.

Season.freezeIntro: Freeze every wish list right now, before the scheduled freeze date. Only matters while the season is open. It does not start the donation split or pay-ups (those follow the freeze date).
Season.freezeOnIntro: Wish lists are frozen by an admin. Unfreeze to go back to the normal dates.
Season.freezeConfirm: I understand: no family can add or remove wish-list items until this is turned off.
Season.datesIntro: Leave a date blank to use the standard one. The season always opens January 1. This season's dates can change until its freeze date.
Season.datesLocked: This season's freeze date has passed, so its dates are locked. Use the emergency freeze if you need to stop changes.

dates.closeDate: First closed day (Dec 26 – 31; the day before is the last day)
dates.blankHelp: Dates start at midnight, Central Time.

errors.invalidDate: One of the dates isn't a real date.
errors.wrongYear: Every date must be in that season's year.
errors.locked: This season's freeze date has passed, so its dates are locked.
errors.changed: Someone else changed these dates meanwhile. Reload the page and try again.
errors.confirmRequired: Tick the box to confirm the freeze.
errors.notOpen: The season isn't open, so there's nothing to freeze.
errors.freezeRange: The freeze date must be between November 1 and December 3 (stores need time to ship by December 10).
errors.closeRange: The first closed day must be between December 26 and December 31 (Christmas Day stays in the season).
errors.freezeTooSoon: A new freeze date must be at least a week away (families may already have been told the old date).
errors.reset_notResetTime: It isn't time for a reset (the season isn't waiting for one).
errors.reset_alreadyDone: Last season's reset is already done.
errors.reset_splitUnfinished: The donation split is still running. Try again in a few minutes.
errors.reset_notFinished: The reset ran but isn't finished yet. Run it again.

Season.freezeOnlyOpen: The emergency freeze can only be switched on while the season is open.
Season.resetIntro: The January 1 reset hasn't finished, so families can't use the site yet. This runs the same job as the nightly cron: last season's unspent Christmas Magic goes to Spirit of Santa, then the new season opens.
Season.resetConfirm: I understand: every child's unspent Christmas Magic from last season goes to Spirit of Santa.

Users.title: Users
Users.intro: Every account (parents, store owners and reps, admins). Children aren't accounts and never appear here.
Users.name: Name
Users.mfaNotSetUp: Not set up yet (asked at next sign-in)
Users.lockedUntil: Sign-in is locked until {when} (too many failed tries).
Users.selfNote: This is your own account: you can't suspend it or reset its two-step sign-in here.
Users.noActions: Nothing to do for this account right now.
Users.reasonHint: Kept in the audit log. They can't sign in until reinstated.

ops.signOutHelp: Ends every session within 5 minutes (e.g. a lost laptop). They can sign in again.
ops.resetMfaHelp: For a lost phone: they'll set up an authenticator app again at their next sign-in.

done.suspend: Suspended. Their sessions end within 5 minutes.
done.signOut: Every session will end within 5 minutes.
done.resetMfa: Two-step sign-in reset. They'll set it up again at their next sign-in.

errors.notFound: That account wasn't found. Reload the page.
errors.self: You can't do that to your own account.
errors.badStatus: The account's status changed meanwhile. Reload the page.
errors.notAdmin: Only admin accounts use two-step sign-in.
errors.reasonRequired: Please give a reason (at least 3 characters).
errors.removedRep: This rep was removed by their store, not suspended by an admin. The store can re-invite them.
errors.notLocked: This account isn't locked (any more). Reload the page.
errors.reasonTooLong: The reason is too long (500 characters at most).

Deeds.title: Good deeds
Deeds.intro: The preset deeds families pick from, in the order they see them.
Deeds.empty: No deeds yet. Add your own, or start from 8 suggested deeds (you can edit or turn off any of them).
Deeds.tipHint: Optional. Shown to the person thanking the child; they can always choose another amount.

errors.notFound: That deed wasn't found. Reload the page.
errors.changed: This deed changed meanwhile. Reload the page.
errors.notEmpty: The list isn't empty any more, so the suggestions weren't added.
errors.invalidAmount: Enter an amount between $0.01 and $1,000, like 5 or 12.50.
errors.minAboveMax: The 'up to' amount must be at least the 'from' amount.

Dashboard.laterNote: Christmas Magic, money and completed deeds appear here once families can earn and tip (Phases 4–5).
Dashboard.pendingTexts: {count, plural, =0 {Nothing waiting for review} one {# item waiting for review} other {# items waiting for review}}

AuditActions.wish_receive: Gift received by Spirit of Santa

Moderation.title: Deed text review
Moderation.intro: Text parents typed for "Something else" deeds. Approve to show it on the public QR page; hide to show "a good deed" instead. Hide anything with names, places or other personal details.
Moderation.aliasesIntro: Shown on public QR pages as "From the … family". Hide real surnames, places or anything unkind.

Settings.title: Settings
Settings.donationsIntro: Gifts on the public donation page are pooled and shared equally among registered children at the season freeze. Spirit of Santa's fee is taken off the top and shown to donors before they give.
Settings.feeHint: 0 to 30, up to two decimals (e.g. 10 or 12.5). Shown on the donation page.
Settings.feeMissing: The platform fee isn't set yet: the public donation page stays closed (and the Dec 1 split won't run) until you save one.
Settings.receiptsHelp: Only switch this on once you've confirmed with the charity (and an accountant) that these donations are received on its behalf.
Settings.savedSent: {count, plural, one {Saved. # waiting receipt was emailed.} other {Saved. # waiting receipts were emailed.}}
Settings.waiting: Receipts are waiting: switch receipts on and fill in the charity's legal name and EIN to send them.

errors.invalid: Something was wrong with the form. Please try again.
errors.fee: Enter a fee between 0 and 30 (up to two decimals).
errors.receiptsNeedCharity: To send receipts, fill in the charity's legal name and EIN.
errors.fromDay: Choose the day receipts start covering gifts.
errors.shippingAddress: Enter the address in up to 6 lines (300 characters).

Settings.fromDayHint: The day the charity arrangement took effect. Gifts before this day never get a receipt.
Settings.before: {count, plural, one {# gift was made before {day} and gets no receipt.} other {# gifts were made before {day} and get no receipt.}}
Settings.shippingHint: Stores ship fully funded gifts here. Shown in store emails and on the store's Orders page. Up to 6 lines.
Settings.shippingMissing: The shipping address isn't set: stores aren't told about funded gifts until you save one.

Donations.title: Community donations
Donations.poolsTitle: Pools for the {year} season (held, not shared yet)
Donations.poolsIntro: If the split ran now: platform fee {fee} off the top, the rest shared equally among registered children. A ZIP with no registered children goes to all children.
Donations.noPools: No gifts are waiting to be shared.
Donations.runIntro: This happens automatically every day while the season is frozen (Dec 1 to Dec 25). Use the button to run it now.

reason.notYet: Pools are shared while the season is frozen (Dec 1 to Dec 25).
reason.feeMissing: Set the platform fee in Settings first.
reason.seasonOver: The season is over: pools are no longer shared (Christmas Magic would be reset on Jan 1). Remaining gifts are handled at the season end.

Donations.confirm: I understand this credits the children's Christmas Magic now and can't be undone.
Donations.retried: {requeued} queued again, {sent} sent now (the rest go out with the daily job).

errors.notYet: Pools are shared while the season is frozen (Dec 1 to Dec 25).
errors.feeMissing: Set the platform fee in Settings first.
errors.seasonOver: The season is over: pools are no longer shared (Christmas Magic would be reset on Jan 1). Remaining gifts are handled at the season end.

Donations.seasonEndIntro: Each Jan 1 the daily job resets every child's Christmas Magic to zero (with a ledger entry) and keeps donation money that was never shared, as the platform's.
Donations.resetLine: Season {year} (finished {when}): {kids} children reset ({points} Christmas Magic), {retained} unshared donation money kept ({gifts} gifts).
Donations.resetRunning: Season {year}: in progress since {when} ({kids} children reset so far). It continues with the next daily run.

Fulfilment.title: Gift fulfilment
Fulfilment.intro: Funded gifts on their way from stores to families. Match packages by the reference code written on them.
Fulfilment.subTitle: Needs a substitute ({count})
Fulfilment.subIntro: Funded when the store had none left. Agree a substitute with the store, write what you agreed, then mark it arranged: the gift goes back to the store's orders.
Fulfilment.note: What was agreed with the store
Fulfilment.transitIntro: The store marked these shipped. Mark each one received when its package arrives.
Fulfilment.sendIntro: We have these. Mark each one sent when it goes to the family: the parent gets an "on its way" email.

errors.notFound: That gift wasn't found. Reload the page.
errors.changed: That gift already moved on (someone else may have done this). Reload the page.
errors.note: Write what was agreed (3 to 300 characters).

Fulfilment.capped: Showing the oldest {shown} of {total}: work through these first.

notice.pending: parent email pending (retried daily for 14 days)
notice.failed: parent email NOT sent: please contact the parent
notice.kept: kept by Spirit of Santa (account deleted)

Fulfilment.addressMissing: No delivery address yet: the parent is asked for it in their parent area. You can also email them.
Fulfilment.addressUnreadable: The saved address can't be read (encryption key changed?). Ask the parent to enter it again.
Fulfilment.familyDeleted: This family deleted its account. There's no one to send it to: Spirit of Santa keeps the gift.
Fulfilment.closingBy: Account closing: send it by {date}, or Spirit of Santa keeps it.

Payouts.title: Store payouts
Payouts.intro: Stores are paid outside the app (check or bank transfer). Record each payment here: it covers every gift the store is owed at that moment.
Payouts.owedIntro: A store is owed for a gift once we've received it. The amount is the gift's price minus the store's agreed discount, fixed when the gift was received.
Payouts.owedLine: {amount} for {count, plural, one {# gift} other {# gifts}}
Payouts.missingAmount: {count, plural, one {# gift has} other {# gifts have}} no amount yet because this store has no discount on record. Set the store's discount (Stores page) before paying.
Payouts.wholesale: Paid or owed to stores ({count, plural, one {# gift} other {# gifts}})
Payouts.paidVsOwed: Still owed to stores (paid so far: {paid})
Payouts.breakage: Breakage: Christmas Magic never spent ({reset} reset Jan 1, {forfeit} from unfinished gifts)
Payouts.moneyNote: Card processing fees aren't included (see the Stripe dashboard). Gifts count once Spirit of Santa received them.

errors.confirm: Tick the box to confirm the amount you sent.
errors.changed: The amount owed changed (a gift was just received). Check the new amount and try again.
errors.notFound: That store wasn't found. Reload the page.
errors.nothingOwed: Nothing is owed to this store right now.
errors.missingAmount: Some gifts have no amount yet (store discount missing). Set the discount first.
errors.invalid: Something was wrong with the form.

field.reference: Keep the reference under 60 characters (no special characters).
field.paidOn: Choose the date the money was sent.
field.note: Keep the note under 300 characters (no special characters).

Payouts.withoutAmount: {count, plural, one {# received gift is} other {# received gifts are}} left out of the wholesale and margin figures: the store has no discount on record yet.
